breaking_news.headline: As crypto and prediction markets expand, their regulator shrinks
breaking_news.summary: Even as the agency is tasked with drawing up new rules for crypto and prediction markets, its staffing and enforcement actions have dropped precipitously during the second Trump administration.

breaking_news.headline: OpenAI caught Russians and Iranians using ChatGPT for influence campaigns
breaking_news.summary: The company says Russian operatives used its AI chatbot to update their bosses, shedding light on influence campaigns previously not attributed to Russia.

breaking_news.headline: Why American investors love European defense startups
breaking_news.summary: As European defense spending takes off, just about half of the funding in Europe's defense tech industry is coming from American investors this year. One reason why: European investment firms have restrictions on how they can invest.

breaking_news.headline: How the oil industry is preparing for Hurricane Isaias
breaking_news.summary: Hurricane Isaias is this season's first Atlantic hurricane, and is on a path to hit the northern Gulf Coast. How is the oil industry preparing?

breaking_news.headline: Despite the controversy, data centers could be attractive to struggling rural towns
breaking_news.summary: There's lots of debate over data centers and where they should be located. In a struggling rural town data center development can look a lot more attractive.

breaking_news.headline: How the beverage aisle got so wild
breaking_news.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

breaking_news.headline: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
breaking_news.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
breaking_news.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

breaking_news.headline: 'Stain on the country': Trump criticises Norway over Nobel Peace Prize
breaking_news.summary: The US president told a rally he had "never heard of" the winner, former International Criminal Court judge Navi Pillay.

breaking_news.headline: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
breaking_news.summary: Tsunami warnings are issued for neighbouring countries as videos of destruction circulate online.

breaking_news.headline: US country music star Ella Langley cancels show due to 'security threat'
breaking_news.summary: Police say they checked the concert venue in Tulsa, Oklahoma but "could not find any threat".

breaking_news.headline: Hurricane Isaias downgraded after making landfall in Florida
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands of households are without power in Florida and Alabama as Isaias continues its path across south-eastern US.

breaking_news.headline: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
breaking_news.summary: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.

breaking_news.headline: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
breaking_news.summary: Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were on a surf trip when they were killed in an apparent botched robbery.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants to reduce the cost of fuel as the midterms loom - will it work?
breaking_news.summary: The price of fuel has soared as the cost of living emerges as a key issue for millions of Americans.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic bans users from being 'cruel' to its AI systems
breaking_news.summary: The firm said users can no longer engage in "sustained and needless" abusive behaviour towards the tech.

breaking_news.headline: I've been with my boyfriend for two years and don't know his salary
breaking_news.summary: Talking about salary, spending habits and debt can be some of dating's trickier conversations.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-Deutsche Bank trader jailed for rigging rates has conviction overturned
breaking_news.summary: The Court of Appeal quashes the conviction of Christian Bittar, a former Deutsche Bank trader jailed in 2018.

breaking_news.headline: Burnham promises to curb non-compete rules in job contracts
breaking_news.summary: The prime minister says restrictions on what workers can do after leaving roles have "gone too far".

breaking_news.headline: Boots has a new owner: Three ways it could affect you
breaking_news.summary: The stalwart of Britain's High Street has been sold to a Canadian billionaire family. What will that mean for you?
